dedupe_keys.name: ilu ds2 carris carris title validation

description: The ILU catalogue identifies CARRIS passenger smart-card validations as a restricted dataset collected through the Lisbon municipality. It gives Lisbon Metropolitan Area as the coverage and CARRIS as the creator. Explicit used relationships connect the collection to dynamic origin-destination inference, LINES resilience analysis and bus-route optimization. The route/schedule GTFS feeds and published ridership maps are separate resources with different contents and rights. These source validations remain subject to a non-disclosure agreement. The metadata do not establish dates, measurement resolution, field definitions, record count or format. Related studies may use distinct extracts; identical samples are not assumed. The accessible project catalogue is a description of the data and does not provide a public dataset endpoint or a verified request workflow. Cost and licence terms remain unknown.
